responseModel: Independent Bernoulli missingness per c/p/v/b request channel. Enumerate all 16 patterns with common outcomes across policies; do not reveal availability until the relevant request. No parameter selection, no Test or frozen 27-source holdout inference.
interpretation: Descriptive Dev sensitivity with fixed checkpoints. This finite expectation removes response-draw variation; it does not add independent retail observations or establish real manager behavior. Preserve original order-dependent historical results separately.
correction: Copy unavailable or partial states only from actual observed replies with preserved source applicability; reject unavailable before any observed failed reply. Raw head predictions and all numeric evidence remain separate.
acceptance: For each of the three fixed policies and all three preregistered missingness probabilities, preserve financial value/type/evidence correctness and no additional false handoffs or redundant requests; reduce resolved-state errors without increasing complete-period total loss. No assertion of learned-head improvement from deterministic observed-state validation. Do not use Test or the frozen 27-source holdout.
